prompt: Overhead flat-lay photograph of heavy, thick-stock paper documents under an architectural housing blueprint and a square of fine metal vent mesh, resting on a matte dark wood surface. Top-down 90-degree view, even diffused daylight casting soft contact shadows. The objects are slightly out of alignment to look handled. Blank and illegibly cropped paper, muted paper tones, brushed steel texture of the mesh contrasting with the matte paperwork. Wide 16:9 framing, generous negative space, sophisticated editorial restraint, moody architectural lighting.
